scripts.check: nub run format:check && nub run lint && nub run typecheck && nub run test
scripts.check:extensions: npm outdated --prefix ~/.pi/agent/npm; git -C ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/championswimmer/pi-context-usage fetch origin && git -C ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/championswimmer/pi-context-usage log --oneline HEAD..origin/HEAD
scripts.format: oxfmt package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json agent/scripts/README.md agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/test agent/extensions/lib tests && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential format
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json agent/scripts/README.md agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/test agent/extensions/lib tests && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential format:check
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings vitest.config.ts agent/extensions/*.ts agent/extensions/test agent/extensions/lib tests && nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential lint
scripts.test: nub run test:setup && TMPDIR=/tmp nub run --recursive --if-present --sequential test
